strategies.name: Variance swap replication by 1/K^2 strip (log contract)

legs.strike_rule: every listed strike K < F0 (forward), weight 2/(T*K^2) per unit strike spacing
every listed strike K > F0, weight 2/(T*K^2) per unit strike spacing
spot/forward; daily re-hedge so the strip plus futures replicates -2/T*ln(S_T/F0) (short log contract)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Short variance swap: payoff = N_var*(K_var - RV^2) where K_var = (2e^{rT}/T)[int_0^{F0} P(K)/K^2 dK + int_{F0}^inf C(K)/K^2 dK] is the fair variance strike (this is the VIX^2 construction for SPX). The strip of options weighted 1/K^2 plus the futures hedge pays -(2/T)ln(S_T/F0) + (2/T)(S_T-F0)/F0, and daily delta hedging converts it into realised variance.
strategies.max_profit: N_var*K_var (if realised variance is zero), i.e. the total premium collected on the strip.
strategies.max_loss: Unbounded: realised variance has no upper bound (a jump of x% adds x^2*252/days to RV^2).
strategies.breakevens: RV^2 = K_var (realised vol equals the strike vol; for SPX, K_var ~ VIX^2/1e4).

greeks_at_inception.gamma: negative, constant dollar gamma across strikes (the 1/K^2 weighting makes gamma flat in S)
greeks_at_inception.vega: negative, flat across strikes: short the whole smile, not just ATM

strategies.when_to_use: The cleanest expression of the variance risk premium: strike is VIX^2 by construction, no path dependence from re-striking, exposure to the whole smile. Long version (buy the strip) is the crash-convex hedge whose payoff is quadratic in moves.
strategies.risks: Truncation: listed strikes do not extend to zero so the replication under-weights the far put tail (the part that pays most in a crash); discretisation error; execution across 20-60 strikes; variance payoff is convex in vol (a doubling of vol quadruples the loss).
strategies.margin_note: Each short option is margined; PM stress tests the whole strip as one position; Reg-T is punitive. SPX/XSP: cash-settled, European, Section 1256. The futures hedge (ES/MES) is SPAN-margined.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit's DVOL is computed by the same 1/K^2 strip logic on BTC options, so a strip at the DVOL expiries replicates DVOL^2 as the strike. Inverse options: payoffs in BTC complicate the log-contract identity (the strip replicates variance of the inverse price unless converted); hedge with the perp, funding is a carry term. Realised variance on 365 days, settle 08:00 UTC.
strategies.metals_notes: GVZ is the GLD-option strip (VIX methodology on GLD), so a GLD 1/K^2 strip replicates GVZ^2; GC options have sparser strikes so discretisation error is larger; American exercise breaks strict replication (early exercise on deep ITM); SPAN margin, 1256.
variants: Long variance strip (crash hedge, long convexity)
Gamma swap (1/K weighting, dollar-gamma constant in S*gamma)
Corridor variance (strip only within [K_lo, K_hi])
Forward-start variance (long far strip, short near strip): term-premium trade
Conditional variance (down-variance only: puts side only)
strategies.claim: The variance swap strike VIX^2 exceeds realised 30-day SPX variance in more than 80% of non-overlapping months since 1990, and the mean log variance risk premium ln(RV^2/VIX^2) is below -0.3, so a short strip earns a positive premium that is paid back in a minority of large-loss months.

trial.statistic: Win rate and mean of ln(RV_{t,t+21}^2 / (VIX_t/100)^2); mean dollar P&L of a short variance swap with N_var sized so vega notional = 1.
trial.null: Win rate <= 50% and mean log VRP >= 0.
trial.procedure: Monthly cycles since 1990 using VIX as the strike (SPX) and SPY (or SPX) closes for RV; studentized block bootstrap; walk-forward; compare to the strip discretised on today's SPX listed strikes (truncation error measured on the current chain).
trial.data: CBOE VIX history, SPY daily closes, today's SPX chain (29,918 contracts) for discretisation error.
trial.pass: Win rate > 0.75 and mean log VRP < -0.2 with 95% CI; strip-vs-VIX^2 truncation error < 5% of strike on the current chain.
trial.controls: Compare with ATM-straddle-only VRP (should be smaller: the smile adds premium); shuffled returns placebo.

strategies.harness_suggestion: Wrap harness_vrp_spx's implied-minus-realised statistic in the log form and add a 'strip_from_chain' function in mandel/options that sums 2/(T*K^2)*mid over the current CBOE chain to compare with VIX^2.

strategies.name: Vega-neutral gamma-positive straddle swap (reverse calendar straddle)

legs.expiry_rule: far (60-90 DTE); qty = sqrt(T_near/T_far) to zero net vega

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: At the near expiry: |S_T - K| - q*Straddle_far(S_T, T_far-T_near, sigma_far) + C0, where q = sqrt(T_near/T_far) and C0 is the net credit/debit. Gamma-scalping P&L accrues from daily re-hedging: sum over days of 0.5*Gamma_net*(dS)^2 - Theta_net*dt, with net vega ~0 at inception.
strategies.max_profit: Unbounded in principle (long near gamma dominates in a large move), minus the far straddle's residual value.
strategies.max_loss: If spot does not move: near straddle expires worthless, far straddle retains value: loss ~ Straddle_near - q*(Straddle_far - Straddle_far_at_T_near), i.e. the net theta paid; further loss if far IV rises after the near leg dies (position then becomes short vega).
strategies.breakevens: Realised vol over the near window above near implied vol by enough to pay the net theta: approx. RV_near^2 > IV_near^2 + (theta imbalance); numerical on the engine grid.

greeks_at_inception.gamma: positive (near gamma >> far gamma per unit vega)
greeks_at_inception.vega: ~0 by construction; becomes short vega after the near leg expires

strategies.when_to_use: When near-dated realised vol is expected to exceed near implied (event clustering, VIX9D < realised, catalysts) but the trader does not want exposure to the level of implied vol; a pure 'realised vs implied' gamma bet with the vega risk sold off.
strategies.risks: Vega neutrality is only instantaneous: the vega ratio drifts with time and spot; after the near expiry the position is net short vol; transaction costs of daily hedging; the far short straddle has unlimited risk if left after the near leg expires.
strategies.margin_note: Short far straddle requires straddle margin (naked short), partly offset by long near straddle under PM; Reg-T treats the short straddle as naked. Index: cash-settled, 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: Natural on Deribit: daily/weekly vs monthly straddles, hedge gamma with the perpetual 24/7 (funding cost adds to theta). Inverse payoff makes gamma in USD terms asymmetric; DVOL vs short-dated realised vol is the public signal.
strategies.metals_notes: GC weekly options vs monthly give the near/far pair; American exercise on the short far leg; SPAN margin. GLD/SLV: same construction with equity options.
variants: Calendar straddle swap with both legs delta-hedged to spot
Gamma swap replication (1/K weighted strip) long near vs short far
Vega-neutral strangle swap (OTM) for cheaper gamma
Ratio by vega AND theta to zero both (needs 3 expiries)
strategies.claim: When VIX9D is below the trailing 10-day realised vol of SPY (short-dated implied under realised), the next 9-trading-day realised variance exceeds VIX9D-implied variance more often than not, so the vega-neutral long-near/short-far straddle swap entered on that signal has positive expectancy.

trial.statistic: Mean of RV(1..9)^2 - VIX9D^2 conditional on VIX9D < RV(-10..0), and win rate; simulated gamma-scalp P&L of the swap with BS Greeks (VIX9D as near IV, VIX3M as far IV).
trial.null: Conditional near-term VRP >= 0 (implied still exceeds realised even when it sits below trailing realised).
trial.procedure: Daily VIX9D (from 2011), VIX3M, SPY closes; non-overlapping 9d cycles; studentized block bootstrap; walk-forward; deflated Sharpe on the simulated P&L.
trial.data: CBOE VIX9D, VIX3M history, SPY daily closes.
trial.pass: Conditional RV^2 - VIX9D^2 > 0 with 95% CI excluding zero and simulated P&L Sharpe > 0 after a 0.5 vol-point round-trip cost.
trial.controls: Unconditional control (should be negative, the VRP); random-entry placebo.

strategies.harness_suggestion: New harness_gamma_swap built on harness_term_structure's index loader plus a daily-rehedge simulator (bs.delta) over SPY closes.

strategies.name: VIX call hedge (rolling long OTM VIX calls)

legs.strike_rule: K = F + 5 to F + 10 vol points (delta ~0.20-0.30 vs the VIX future)
legs.expiry_rule: 30-60 DTE VIX monthly, rolled 1-2 weeks before expiry

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: max(SOQ - K, 0) - C0; convex in VIX: a 10-point VIX rise above K pays 10x100 = $1,000 per contract; paired with an equity book the payoff is approximately -beta_vix*Return_SPX when the shock is large.
strategies.max_profit: Unbounded in VIX (VIX reached 82 in 2020).
strategies.max_loss: C0 per cycle (the premium), bled every month the shock does not come.

greeks_at_inception.delta: positive to VIX futures (negative to SPX)
greeks_at_inception.theta: negative (large: VIX calls carry high vol-of-vol premium and roll-down drag in contango)

strategies.when_to_use: Tail hedge for an equity or short-vol book when VIX and VVIX are low (calls cheap in points) and term structure is in contango; convex payoff that does not require picking the strike on SPX; often cheaper per unit of crash protection than SPX puts when skew is rich.
strategies.risks: Persistent negative carry (contango roll-down pulls the future toward spot each month); VIX options settle on the Wednesday AM SOQ which can be far from the prior close; the hedge is on the VIX future, not spot: in a slow grind lower the future lags spot VIX.
strategies.margin_note: Long premium only. VIX options: cash-settled, European, multiplier 100, AM settlement, Section 1256 60/40.
strategies.crypto_notes: No US-listed vol-index options for BTC; the analogue is a far-OTM BTC put on Deribit or IBIT (direct tail) or a long BTC straddle far-dated; Deribit DVOL has no tradable derivative in the US.
strategies.metals_notes: No GVZ options; gold tail hedge is via GC/GLD puts (or GLD calls for 'flight to safety' convexity).
variants: Call spread hedge (long K1, short K2) to cut carry
1x2 call ratio hedge (long 1 K1, short 2 K2) near zero cost, but short the extreme tail
VIX call ladder
UVXY calls (2x leveraged, path-dependent decay)
Calendar of VIX calls (long far, short near) to monetise contango
strategies.claim: A rolling 1-month 25-delta VIX call hedge sized at 1% of an SPY portfolio per year costs less than the drawdown reduction it buys: the hedged portfolio's deflated Sharpe and max drawdown improve relative to unhedged SPY over 2007-2026, when the call is priced on the VIX3M/VIX-implied forward with VVIX as IV.

trial.statistic: Difference in deflated Sharpe and in max drawdown between hedged and unhedged SPY series; hedge P&L per cycle.
trial.null: Hedged Sharpe <= unhedged Sharpe (the carry costs more than the convexity is worth).
trial.procedure: Monthly cycles since 2007 (VVIX start); BS-priced VIX call on F = sqrt((3*VIX3M^2 - VIX^2)/2) with sigma = VVIX/100; payoff on VIX at expiry (spot VIX as SOQ proxy); studentized block bootstrap of the Sharpe difference; walk-forward sizing.
trial.data: CBOE VIX, VIX3M, VVIX history; SPY closes.
trial.pass: Hedged max drawdown reduced by > 25% and Sharpe difference >= 0 with 95% CI not excluding a positive value; cost-of-carry < 2% per year.
trial.controls: SPX 10-delta put hedge with the same budget (model-priced with VIX IV) as the alternative; cash drag control.

strategies.harness_suggestion: Monthly model-priced overlay in the harness_vrp_spx style with the VVIX-as-IV pricer; report hedged vs unhedged via harness_controls.

strategies.name: VIX call spread and call ratio (defined-cost vol hedge / vol-of-vol sale)

legs.strike_rule: K1 = F + 3 to F + 5 (delta ~0.35 vs VIX future)
K2 = K1 + 10 to K1 + 15 (qty 2 for the 1x2 ratio variant)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: 1x1: min(max(SOQ-K1,0), K2-K1) - D0. 1x2 ratio: max(SOQ-K1,0) - 2*max(SOQ-K2,0) - D0 (often D0 ~ 0): peaks at K2 with (K2-K1) - D0 and declines above, going negative above 2*K2 - K1 - D0.
strategies.max_profit: 1x1: (K2 - K1) - D0 at SOQ >= K2. 1x2: (K2 - K1) - D0 at SOQ = K2.
strategies.max_loss: 1x1: D0. 1x2: unbounded above 2*K2 - K1 - D0 (short the extreme tail: a VIX print above ~60-80 hurts).
strategies.breakevens: 1x1: K1 + D0. 1x2: K1 + D0 (lower) and 2*K2 - K1 - D0 (upper).

greeks_at_inception.gamma: positive near K1, negative near K2
greeks_at_inception.theta: 1x1 mildly negative; 1x2 near zero or positive
greeks_at_inception.vega: 1x1 small positive to VVIX; 1x2 short VVIX (sells the convexity of the upper strike)

strategies.when_to_use: Hedge a moderate vol spike (VIX 25-40) at lower carry than outright calls; the 1x2 sells the very far tail where VIX options' implied vol (VVIX) is richest, financing the hedge; used when VVIX is high relative to realised vol of VIX.
strategies.risks: 1x1: protection capped at K2 in a 2008/2020-type event. 1x2: the position becomes short in exactly the catastrophic scenario; SOQ settlement risk; roll timing.
strategies.margin_note: 1x1 debit spread: no margin. 1x2: the extra short call is naked: VIX call margin is high (VIX is treated as a volatile broad index; many brokers require 20%+ of futures level). Cash-settled, Section 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: Not directly available; BTC analogue is a far-OTM put spread / put ratio on Deribit or IBIT.
strategies.metals_notes: Not directly available; use GLD/GC put spreads or call spreads depending on the shock direction (gold rallied in 2020 then fell in the liquidity squeeze).
variants: 1x1 call spread (defined cost)
1x2 and 1x3 call ratios (zero cost, short far tail)
Call spread collar: short VIX put to finance (short vol below F)
Diagonal call spread (long far-dated K1, short near-dated K2)
strategies.claim: VVIX overstates the realised volatility of VIX (the vol-of-vol risk premium is positive), so selling the upper strike of a VIX call spread (the 1x2 ratio) recovers more premium on average than the expected payoff it gives up: realised 30-day vol of log VIX changes is below VVIX in more than 70% of months.

trial.statistic: Mean and win rate of VVIX_t^2 - RV_vix(t..t+21)^2 where RV_vix is the annualised realised variance of daily log VIX changes; simulated 1x2 P&L priced with VVIX as IV on the forward F.
trial.null: VVIX is an unbiased forecast of VIX realised vol (premium <= 0).
trial.procedure: Daily VVIX (from 2007) and VIX; non-overlapping 21d windows; studentized block bootstrap; walk-forward; note that realised vol of spot VIX is higher than of the future (bias against the claim, which is conservative).
trial.data: CBOE VVIX and VIX history, VIX3M for the forward proxy.
trial.pass: Win rate > 0.65 and mean premium > 0 at p<0.01; simulated 1x2 P&L positive after costs with max loss months reported.
trial.controls: Compare to SPX VRP (VIX^2 vs RV^2) for scale; shuffled VVIX placebo.

strategies.harness_suggestion: New harness_vvix_vrp using cboe_index_history('VVIX') with realised vol of log VIX; reuse harness_vrp_spx structure.

strategies.name: VIX futures roll-down harvest via short VIX call spread

legs.strike_rule: ATM relative to the VIX future of the same expiry (K1 = F)
K2 = F + 5 to F + 10 vol points

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Credit C0 = C(K1) - C(K2). Payoff = C0 - min(max(SOQ - K1, 0), K2 - K1): full credit if VIX SOQ settles below K1 (the future rolls down toward spot in contango), max loss if SOQ > K2.
strategies.max_profit: C0 (SOQ <= K1).
strategies.when_to_use: When the VIX term structure is in contango (VIX3M > VIX, front future > spot): the future converges down to spot over the month absent a shock; sell the roll-down with a defined-risk call spread rather than naked.
strategies.risks: Vol spikes are fast and large (VIX can double in days); the spread caps loss but the credit is small relative to width; VIX options settle on the special opening quotation (SOQ) which can diverge from the prior close; Wednesday AM expiry.
strategies.margin_note: Defined risk: margin = width - credit. VIX options are cash-settled, European, multiplier 100, Section 1256. Note VIX options price off the VIX future of the same expiry, not spot VIX, so the 'ATM' strike is the futures level.
strategies.crypto_notes: No listed DVOL futures/options in the US yet; the crypto analogue is selling the Deribit BTC term-structure contango via a reverse calendar on BTC options (see calendar entry). Volmex BVIV exists but has no US-regulated options.
strategies.metals_notes: No tradable GVZ futures/options currently; metals term-structure roll is expressed via GC/GLD calendars.
variants: Short VXX call spread (same bet via the ETN, no SOQ risk, American)
Long VIX put spread (K2 < F, debit) as the mirror
Short VIX call spread financed long SPX put spread (cross-hedge)
Ladder: short K1 call, long K2 and K3 calls
strategies.claim: When VIX3M exceeds VIX by more than 10% (contango), spot VIX 21 trading days later is below the VIX3M-VIX-implied 1-month forward level F = sqrt((3*VIX3M^2 - VIX^2)/2) in more than 65% of months, so a VIX call spread struck at F has positive expectancy.

trial.statistic: Frequency and mean of F_t - VIX_{t+21} conditional on VIX3M/VIX > 1.10; simulated P&L of the call spread priced with BS on F using VVIX as IV.
trial.null: VIX_{t+21} >= F on average (the forward is unbiased or too low).
trial.procedure: Daily VIX, VIX3M, VVIX since 2007; non-overlapping 21d cycles; studentized block bootstrap; walk-forward threshold; deflated Sharpe; sensitivity to using actual VIX futures when CFE settlement history is added.
trial.data: CBOE VIX, VIX3M, VVIX history (VIX futures settlement history is not in the free set; F from VIX3M/VIX is the proxy).
trial.pass: Conditional frequency > 0.60 with 95% CI above 0.5 and mean F - VIX_{t+21} > 0 at p<0.05; simulated call-spread Sharpe > 0.5 after 0.10 vol-point costs.
trial.controls: Unconditional (no contango filter) control; shuffled term-structure placebo.

strategies.harness_suggestion: Extend harness_term_structure with the forward-level proxy F and a VIX-call-spread pricer (bs.price with sigma = VVIX/100, T from the VIX monthly calendar).

strategies.name: VIX spike mean-reversion via long VIX put / put spread

legs.strike_rule: K2 = F (ATM vs the VIX future of that expiry)
K1 = F - 5 to F - 8 (optional, to make a put spread)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Put spread: min(max(K2 - SOQ, 0), K2 - K1) - D0. Outright put: max(K2 - SOQ, 0) - D0. Profits when VIX falls back toward its long-run level after a spike and backwardation.
strategies.max_profit: Put spread: (K2 - K1) - D0. Outright: K2 - D0 (VIX cannot go below ~9).

greeks_at_inception.delta: negative to VIX futures (positive to SPX)
greeks_at_inception.theta: negative but mitigated: in backwardation the future rolls DOWN toward... (actually up toward spot) - theta plus roll are the cost

strategies.when_to_use: After a VIX spike (VIX > 30, VIX > VIX3M: backwardation) when the futures curve already prices a decline; the put spread monetises the mean reversion with defined risk; the futures-implied forward is BELOW spot VIX in backwardation, so the put must be struck on the future, not spot.
strategies.risks: Spikes cluster (Aug 2015, Feb 2018, Mar 2020, Aug 2024): the second leg of a crisis can send VIX higher; the future is already below spot so part of the expected decline is priced; SOQ risk.
strategies.margin_note: Debit only. VIX options cash-settled, European, 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: BTC analogue: after a DVOL spike, sell a BTC straddle or buy a BTC call spread (vol spikes in crypto are often on the way down with reversal rallies); Deribit inverse, 24/7, settle 08:00 UTC.
strategies.metals_notes: After a GVZ spike, short GLD straddle / GC strangle; GC American on futures, SPAN.
variants: Outright ATM VIX put
Put spread (defined)
Short VIX call spread as the credit version
Short VXX / long SVXY calls (ETN route)
Long SPX call spread as the directional twin
strategies.claim: When VIX closes above 30 and above VIX3M (backwardation), spot VIX 21 trading days later is below the VIX3M/VIX-implied forward F in fewer than 50% of cases (the curve already prices the decline), but is below spot VIX in more than 75% of cases: an ATM-on-the-forward put spread has positive expectancy only when struck at spot, and the claim is that the excess reversion beyond F is not significant.

trial.statistic: Frequencies P(VIX_{t+21} < F_t) and P(VIX_{t+21} < VIX_t) conditional on VIX_t > 30 and VIX_t > VIX3M_t; simulated P&L of the put spread struck at F vs at spot (priced with VVIX as IV).
trial.null: P(VIX_{t+21} < F) = 0.5 (the forward is an unbiased forecast after spikes).
trial.procedure: Daily VIX, VIX3M, VVIX since 2007; event entries with 21d hold, non-overlapping; exact binomial CI and studentized block bootstrap; walk-forward.
trial.data: CBOE VIX, VIX3M, VVIX history.
trial.pass: Report both frequencies with CIs; strategy passes only if P(VIX_{t+21} < F) > 0.5 with the 95% CI excluding 0.5, otherwise record 'forward is fair' as the finding.
trial.controls: All-days baseline; VIX > 30 without backwardation.

strategies.harness_suggestion: Add a 'backwardation event' study to harness_term_structure; event count will be small (~25-40 since 2007), report exact CIs.

strategies.name: Vol-of-vol trade: VIX straddle / strangle vs VVIX

legs.strike_rule: K2 = F + 5 (OTM vs the VIX future)
K1 = F - 3 (OTM; VIX floor ~10 limits the downside)
VIX future delta hedge (or skip; VIX options are rarely delta-hedged by retail)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Short VIX strangle: C0 - max(SOQ - K2, 0) - max(K1 - SOQ, 0). Sells vol-of-vol: profits when VVIX-implied VIX movement exceeds the realised movement of the VIX future to settlement. Reverse (long VIX straddle) when VVIX is low ahead of a catalyst.
strategies.max_profit: C0 (SOQ in [K1, K2]).
strategies.max_loss: Upside unbounded (SOQ - K2 - C0); downside K1 - C0 (VIX has a practical floor near 9-10, so the put side is limited).

greeks_at_inception.delta: ~0 to the VIX future (asymmetric: short put side has a floor)

strategies.when_to_use: Short when VVIX is in its top quartile relative to the realised vol of VIX and the term structure is in contango (the future drifts down into the put strike slowly); long VIX straddle when VVIX < 85 and a macro catalyst is dated.
strategies.risks: VIX options have log-normal-like upside and bounded downside: the short call side carries all the risk and is where 2018/2020 losses occurred; VVIX itself spikes to 150-200 in crises; SOQ settlement.
strategies.margin_note: Short VIX strangle margin is heavy (naked VIX calls); PM stress uses large VIX moves (+/-50%+). Cash-settled, European, 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: No DVOL options; vol-of-vol in BTC is traded via calendars of straddles or by trading the DVOL-realised spread over short windows on Deribit.
strategies.metals_notes: Not available (no GVZ derivatives).
variants: Long VIX straddle when VVIX low (vol-of-vol purchase)
Short VIX call + long VIX put (synthetic short future with skew)
VIX iron condor (defined-risk short vol-of-vol)
VIX straddle calendar (long far, short near)
strategies.claim: The 30-day realised volatility of the VIX (annualised stdev of daily log changes) is below VVIX by more than 10 vol points on average, and the gap is widest when VVIX is in its top quartile, so a short VIX strangle sized on VVIX has a positive vol-of-vol premium outside crisis months.

trial.statistic: Mean of VVIX_t - RV_vix(t..t+21) overall and by VVIX quartile; simulated short VIX strangle P&L priced with VVIX as IV on the forward F; crisis-month losses tabulated.
trial.null: VVIX - RV_vix <= 0 on average or not increasing in VVIX quartile.
trial.procedure: Daily VVIX and VIX since 2007; non-overlapping 21d cycles; studentized block bootstrap; quartile monotonicity test (harness_horizon_monotone pattern); deflated Sharpe.
trial.data: CBOE VVIX, VIX, VIX3M history.
trial.pass: Mean gap > 10 with 99% CI excluding zero; quartile means monotone increasing; simulated Sharpe > 0.3 after costs with worst-month loss < 5x average monthly gain.
trial.controls: Shuffled VVIX placebo; realised vol of the forward proxy F instead of spot VIX as a lower-variance check.

strategies.harness_suggestion: Same harness_vvix_vrp as the VIX call ratio entry; add the quartile split and a strangle pricer.

strategies.name: VRP harvest: delta-hedged short ATM straddle

legs.strike_rule: spot (delta hedge daily to zero; qty starts ~0 and tracks -delta)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Unhedged: C0 - |S_T - K| where C0 is the straddle credit. Hedged: P&L ~ sum over days of 0.5*Gamma*(dS)^2 - Theta*dt ~ (Vega/2sigma)*(IV^2 - RV^2)*T: short variance at strike IV^2 in the amount of dollar gamma.
strategies.max_profit: Unhedged: C0 at S_T = K. Hedged: approx. 0.5*Vega*(IV - RV_realised) scaled, bounded by C0 if RV -> 0.
strategies.max_loss: Unhedged: unbounded above, K - C0 below. Hedged: unbounded in realised variance (gap risk; a jump realises variance that cannot be hedged).
strategies.breakevens: Unhedged: K +/- C0 (OIC). Hedged: RV_realised = IV_entry (approximately, with path dependence).
strategies.when_to_use: Default short-vol harvest: implied variance of equity indices exceeds subsequently realised variance on average (variance risk premium, Carr-Wu); size by IV - realised-forecast spread; avoid into known events.
strategies.risks: Crash/jump risk; vol-of-vol and correlation of losses with equity drawdowns; hedging transaction costs; margin calls when VIX spikes; the premium is compensation for exactly these.
strategies.margin_note: Naked straddle margin: greater of the two legs' naked requirements plus the other premium (Reg-T); PM: stress -12%/+10% for broad index. SPX/XSP cash-settled, European, Section 1256 60/40; SPY American with assignment risk.
strategies.crypto_notes: On Deribit the straddle is priced and settled in BTC (inverse); delta-hedge with the BTC perpetual and account for funding (often positive carry for the short-perp hedge in bull markets). DVOL is the 30-day implied index; realised vol computed on 365 days. BTC VRP is positive on average but has larger negative tails; weekend realised vol matters since the market is 24/7.
strategies.metals_notes: Gold VRP via GLD straddles (GVZ is the implied index) or GC options (American, SPAN, 1256, exercise into futures: an assigned straddle leg becomes a futures position to flatten). Silver via SLV/SI; SI implied vol is ~2x gold's.
variants: Short strangle (10-20 delta) delta-hedged
Iron condor / iron butterfly (defined risk)
Short straddle unhedged (income family)
Weekly short straddles rolled weekly
Vol-targeted sizing: notional proportional to 1/VIX
strategies.claim: The 30-day variance risk premium on the S&P 500, VIX^2 minus subsequently realised 21-day variance of SPY, is positive on average, so a delta-hedged short ATM straddle priced at VIX has positive mean return per monthly cycle after a 0.5 vol-point round-trip cost.

trial.statistic: Mean of (VIX_t/100)^2 - RV_{t,t+21} (annualised), and mean P&L of the BS-priced, daily-rehedged short straddle per cycle.
trial.procedure: Monthly non-overlapping cycles since 1993 (SPY inception); studentized block bootstrap; walk-forward thirds; deflated Sharpe vs the number of sizing variants tried.
trial.data: CBOE VIX history, SPY daily closes, FRED 3m bill rate.
trial.pass: Mean VRP > 0 with 99% CI excluding zero; strategy Sharpe > 0.5 after costs with deflated Sharpe p<0.05; positive in all three walk-forward thirds.
trial.controls: Buy-and-hold SPY benchmark (harness_controls); shuffled-VIX placebo.

strategies.harness_suggestion: harness_vrp_spx and harness_short_straddle already compute this; add the daily-rehedge path and costs; cross-asset twins harness_vrp_nasdaq/russell/gold/oil/bonds/btc/eth.

strategies.name: VXX / UVXY decay harvest with options (put spreads, call spreads, diagonals)
strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Put spread: min(max(K2 - S_T, 0), K2 - K1) - D0 where S_T is VXX at expiry. VXX tracks a constant-30-day VIX futures position rolled daily from month 1 into month 2; in contango the daily roll loses (F2 - F1)/F1 per month (~5-10%), which drives the expected decline of S_T.
strategies.max_loss: D0 (defined). Short-call variants: unbounded (VXX can triple in weeks).

greeks_at_inception.theta: negative on the debit but offset by the expected roll decay of the underlying
greeks_at_inception.vega: positive to VXX IV (which is itself a function of VVIX)

strategies.when_to_use: When VIX term structure is in steep contango (VIX3M/VIX > 1.1, M2/M1 futures > 1.05): the ETN bleeds roll yield, so long put spreads or short call spreads on VXX/UVXY harvest the decay with defined risk; SVXY (inverse -0.5x) call spreads express the same view.
strategies.risks: Spikes: VXX +100-300% in weeks (Feb 2018, Mar 2020) wipe out short calls; put spreads lose the debit; UVXY is 1.5x-2x leveraged and path-dependent (volatility drag both ways); ETN issuer credit risk (Barclays); reverse splits; the ETN can be delisted/accelerated (XIV 2018).
strategies.margin_note: Put spread: debit. Short calls on VXX/UVXY: brokers often require 50-100% margin (high-vol class). American, physically settled; ETN/ETF shares. Not Section 1256 (ordinary equity options). SVXY is an ETF (K-1 partnership until recently; check current structure).
strategies.crypto_notes: No listed BTC vol ETN in the US; BITO (covered-call BTC futures ETF) and leveraged BTC ETFs (BITX) have options and similar path-dependent decay; Deribit has no DVOL product.
strategies.metals_notes: No gold-vol ETN; leveraged metals ETFs (UGL, AGQ, NUGT) carry volatility drag and have options: the same decay-harvest logic (long put spread) applies with much smaller carry.
variants: Long VXX put spread (defined)
Short VXX call spread (credit, defined)
VXX put diagonal (long far ATM put, short near OTM put)
UVXY put spread (2x leverage, faster decay)
SVXY call spread (long inverse vol)
Short VXX stock / long VXX call (synthetic put) for hard-to-borrow regimes
strategies.claim: When VIX3M/VIX > 1.10 at entry, the 21-trading-day return of VXX is below -5% on average and negative in more than 65% of months, so a 60-90 DTE ATM/-20% put spread on VXX entered on that signal has positive expectancy after the debit.

trial.statistic: Mean and win rate of 21d VXX log return conditional on VIX3M/VIX > 1.10; simulated put-spread P&L priced with BS on VXX using a VXX IV proxy (VVIX-scaled) until chain captures exist.
trial.null: Conditional mean VXX return >= 0 (no harvestable roll decay).
trial.procedure: Daily VXX closes (2009-), VIX, VIX3M; non-overlapping 21d cycles; studentized block bootstrap; walk-forward threshold; deflated Sharpe; replace the IV proxy with surface_summary VXX IVs after 60 captures.
trial.data: VXX/UVXY/SVXY daily closes (not yet in the free set; fetchable from stooq/yahoo closes), VIX, VIX3M history; daily VXX chain capture.
trial.pass: Conditional mean < -0.03 with 95% CI excluding zero; simulated P&L positive with deflated Sharpe p<0.05.
trial.controls: Unconditional VXX drift (should also be negative); random-entry placebo; worst-month table.

strategies.blocked_on: VXX/UVXY/SVXY daily close history (add to the closes fetch) and daily VXX chain capture, ~60 days for real IVs; the VIX3M/VIX contango-conditioned proxy (VIX spot drift) is testable now via harness_term_structure.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Add VXX/UVXY/SVXY to CHAIN_SYMBOLS and to the daily closes fetch; then a harness_vxx_decay in the harness_term_structure style.
